On a phone with no Google services — de-Googled, LineageOS, a Huawei — take [Blazify.apk](https://github.com/rajendra7169/blazify/releases/latest/download/Blazify.apk) below instead: the same app, without playing to a television.
--- ## Highlights - **Opens about twice as fast** — Home appears in roughly half the time it used to, straight from the launch screen, on every phone - **A new look for loading** — Blazify's own logo tells its little story wherever the app waits. No separate splash screen any more - **Browse, mood and genre pages, redone** — the moods, then Genres under their own heading, ordered by what you listen to; mood pages open whole with big cards and songs as a list, with a placeholder in the right shape while they load - **Smoother on every phone** — Search scrolls smoothly again, Home's shelves are reused as they scroll, and the screen rests when nothing is changing - **Updates keep coming even if GitHub doesn't answer** — the app falls back to Blazify's own website, downloads from GitLab and then Codeberg, and picks up a dropped download where it stopped ## New features - **One button row for playlists and albums** — like and download on the left, Play in the middle, shuffle and more on the right; a playlist from Browse downloads in one tap - Lists open on the song that is playing, instead of a Jump to playing button - Download sits among the first tiles of a song's menu - Every cover shows the Blazify mark while it loads, or when a song has none - Home's greeting card takes the colour of the song that is playing - Blaze Together runs on Blazify's own server, and says why if a room can't be made ## Fixes and improvements - **Quick picks, Daily discover and radio find related songs again** — YouTube had moved them, and Quick picks fell to a single song - Forgotten favourites holds the songs you have stopped playing, not only the ones you still play - Choosing another song after one failed to load now plays it, instead of staying on the error - A song link that opens Blazify always plays, even when it arrives before the player is ready - Fixed a crash when a cover could not load, for example with no connection - Pressing Next shows the new cover at once instead of a placeholder - Quick picks stay where they first appear instead of reshuffling a few seconds after Home opens - Video Art plays through a song's last 45 seconds instead of freezing, picks the official video closest in length to the song, and goes round again when the video is shorter - Better Lyrics signs in when a song plays, not when the app opens - Onboarding stays inside the screen edges, so Skip can always be pressed - A finished update download is kept even when its name is already taken in Downloads --- **Also on this page:** `Blazify.apk` for phones without Google services, and `Blazify-izzy-9.17.0.apk`, the build with no updater for F-Droid-style repositories. **Full changelog**: https://github.com/rajendra7169/blazify/compare/v9.16.0...v9.17.0
